research.title: Contradiction-Aware Evidence Selection for Extractive Question Answering
bullets: Formulated a research question on whether conflicting retrieved passages undermine answer selection when lexical relevance remains high.
Led development of an evidence reranking method combining relevance and textual entailment scores; evaluated answer consistency through controlled passage substitutions.

research.title: Uncertainty-Aware Text Classification Under Domain Shift
bullets: Investigated how domain shift affects selective text classification, separating errors associated with vocabulary changes from failures of confidence calibration.
Led development of a domain-aware confidence calibrator using representation similarity; evaluated abstention behavior with cross-domain splits, ablations, and qualitative error analysis.

work.title: Support Ticket Processing and Routing
bullets: Implemented ticket normalization and routing components within an existing service, following specified handling rules for missing fields and duplicate submissions.
Added regression tests for routing changes, investigated malformed input failures, and documented expected behavior for maintenance and handoff.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Document Search
bullets: Implemented term-weighted and dense embedding retrieval baselines over a shared document collection, using consistent preprocessing and query evaluation splits.
Compared ranking quality and retrieval latency, then inspected failed queries involving paraphrases, rare terms, and mismatched document granularity.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented recurrent and transformer-based sequence labeling baselines with aligned tokenization, padding masks, and consistent entity span decoding.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, examining boundary errors and performance differences between frequent entities and previously unseen surface forms.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Sentence Ranking
bullets: Implemented frequency-based and graph-based sentence ranking methods, applying a shared length budget and redundancy filtering to generated summaries.
Compared lexical overlap scores and manually inspected summaries for repeated content, missing central facts, and unresolved references.

projects.title: Subword Tokenization for Morphologically Varied Text
bullets: Implemented byte-pair and unigram tokenization pipelines for a shared text corpus, controlling normalization and vocabulary allocation across comparisons.
Compared sequence lengths and reconstruction behavior, inspecting segmentation patterns for inflected words, uncommon names, and mixed-script inputs.
